caption: A quiet morning in the miniature district, just a few feet away from the city's busiest bakery. The residents are out early, enjoying the crisp air and the familiar routine of the cobblestone streets. It's a peaceful start, though some of the neighbors might find the sudden white blizzard a bit of an unexpected morning surprise.
